notes.subject: ⟨ke⟩
notes.rationale: Seheberu se se na copula; Sepedi e e nyaka

notes.subject: dikgokaganyetšo
notes.rationale: עבות ke dithapo tše kgobilego/dikgokagano tša go goga; BSB e ra 'o nkgaile' (go tšwa go dikgokagano) — go kgaola ke go bala ga gona

notes.subject: עבות
notes.rationale: modumo o tšwana le עב ('motho wa mošomo wa ka ntle') ka Ecclesiastes 4:12 — thapo e nonyane ya go se kgone go kgokaganetša; go latelwa ke dikgokaganyetšo tša Sepedi

translation: Yahwe ⟨ke⟩ toko, o ile a kgaola dikgokaganyetšo tša ba fošagetšego.
